title: Inside Lowe’s Hurricane Isaias disaster relief effort
summary: Inside Lowe’s Hurricane Isaias disaster relief effort
body_markdown:
When Hurricane Isaias left its mark on Northeast communities, Lowe’s associates wasted no time stepping in to help neighbors start picking up the pieces.


Across some of the hardest-hit towns, 1,440 disaster relief buckets made their way to six local stores. Through the Bucket Brigade program, associates handed out essential cleanup supplies, offering a helping hand to those facing the aftermath of the storm.


For Lowe’s, it’s part of a larger commitment to standing by communities before, during, and after severe weather, ensuring support is ready when recovery begins.


For associates in these communities, it’s about showing up where help matters most and making sure neighbors have what they need to start rebuilding homes and restoring a sense of normalcy.
